title: VIXEN FidelityFX custom commands hash the ambient PATH
body: FidelityFXFsr3.cmake embedded the caller's ambient PATH in every FidelityFX_SC.exe custom-command environment. The live box queue supplies a different temporary PATH per invocation, so Ninja marked all 40 shader-blob edges dirty even when the SDK inputs and output cache were unchanged. Recovery changed the command environment to the SDK-only tool directory, which contains FidelityFX_SC.exe and glslangValidator.exe. Make the shader command hash depend only on its declared tool directory or provide a stable queue environment.

title: VIXEN glyph layout codegen target used retired file-output CLI flags
body: The queued glyph_outline_instance_regen target failed against the f394 kernel tool because VIXEN/codegen/CMakeLists.txt passed --out-cpp, --out-glsl, and --out-layout-hash, while the canonical --recipe-parameter-block contract requires --out-cpp-dir, --out-glsl-dir, and --out-layout-hash-dir and emits dependency files (PathPoint/PathSegment) into those directories. I had to repair both WSL and native CMake branches by hand before the codegen check passed. Suggested consolidation: derive consumer output-directory arguments from the CodegenTool module contract or provide a compatibility wrapper so generated dependency closure and output paths cannot drift.

title: Kernel CodegenTool materializer emits NETSDK1188 locale warnings
body: Building the f394 kernel CodegenTool through the queued VIXEN codegen path emitted 26 NETSDK1188 warnings from Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.Common/CSharp 4.8.0 resource locales (cs, de, es, fr, it, ja, ko, pl, pt-br, ru, tr, zh-hans, zh-hant), although the direct tool build still completed. The warning source is the shared package materializer/SDK restore rather than consumer code. Suggested consolidation: normalize or exclude invalid NuGet locale resource folders during the provisioned tool build so clean codegen witnesses remain warning-free.
